theorem hockeyM6E1 (n k : ℕ) :
 (∑ t ∈ range (n+1), t.choose k)=(n+1).choose (k+1)

theorem binconvM6E1 (n r s : ℕ) :
 (∑ t ∈ range (n+1), t.choose r*(n-t).choose s)=(n+1).choose (r+s+1)

theorem choose_productM6E1 (t l b : ℕ) :
 (t+l).choose l*t.choose b=(t+l).choose (l+b)*(l+b).choose l

theorem shifted_binconvM6E1 (n l b r s : ℕ) (hl : l ≤ r) (hb : b ≤ s) :
 (∑ t ∈ range (n+1), (t+l).choose r*(n-t+b).choose s)=
 (n+l+b+1).choose (r+s+1)

theorem fib_globalM6E1 (n l t : ℕ) (hl : 1≤l) (ht : t<n) :
 coeff (fib6 n) l t=((n-t-1).choose (l-1):ℤ)*((t+l).choose l:ℤ)

theorem central_pairM6E1 (n l b : ℕ) (hl : 1≤l) (hb : 1≤b) :
 (∑ t ∈ range (n+1), coeff (fib6 (n+1)) l t*coeff (fib6 (n+1)) b (n-t))=
 ((l+b-1).choose l:ℤ)*((l+b-1).choose b:ℤ)*
   ((n+l+b+1).choose (2*(l+b)-1):ℤ)

theorem central_square_formulaM6E1 (n i : ℕ) (hi : 2 ≤ i) :
 coeff (fib6 (n+1)^2) i n=
 ((2*i-2).choose (i-2):ℤ)*((n+i+1).choose (2*i-1):ℤ)
theorem central_nonnegM6E1 (q k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ centralValM6E1 q k
theorem central_zeroM6E1 (q k : ℕ) (hk : q<k) : centralValM6E1 q k=0

theorem central_scaledM6E1 (q k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) :
 (2*(k:ℤ)+3)*centralValM6E1 q k=(2*(q:ℤ)+3)*centralAuxM6E1 q k

theorem central_aux_stepM6E1 (q k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ q) :
 ((k:ℤ)+1)*(k+3)*centralAuxM6E1 q (k+1)=
 ((q:ℤ)+k+3)*(q-k)*centralAuxM6E1 q k

theorem central_stepM6E1 (q k : ℕ) (hk : k+1 ≤ q) :
 (2*(k:ℤ)+5)*(k+1)*(k+3)*centralValM6E1 q (k+1)=
 ((q:ℤ)+k+3)*(q-k)*(2*k+3)*centralValM6E1 q k
definitions:
def centralAuxM6E1 (q k : ℕ) : ℤ :=
 ((q+k+2).choose k:ℤ)*((q+2).choose (k+2):ℤ)

theorem central_ratio_gapM6E1 (k r : ℤ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
 0 ≤ centralBM6E1 (k+2+r) k*centralAM6E1 (k+1)-
   centralBM6E1 (k+2+r) (k+1)*centralAM6E1 k

theorem central_gapM6E1 (q k L M R : ℤ)
 (h0 : centralAM6E1 k*M=centralBM6E1 q k*L)
 (h1 : centralAM6E1 (k+1)*R=centralBM6E1 q (k+1)*M) :
 centralAM6E1 k*centralAM6E1 (k+1)*(M^2-L*R)=
 (centralBM6E1 q k*centralAM6E1 (k+1)-centralBM6E1 q (k+1)*centralAM6E1 k)*L*M

theorem central_lcM6E1 (q k : ℕ) :
 centralValM6E1 q k*centralValM6E1 q (k+2) ≤ centralValM6E1 q (k+1)^2

theorem central_square_lowM6E1 (n i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ 1) :

theorem central_two_formulaM6E1 (q k : ℕ) :
 coeff (fib6 (q+2)^2+V*fib6 (q+1)^2) (k+2) (q+1)=centralValM6E1 (q+1) k

theorem central_two_lowM6E1 (q i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ 1) :

theorem central_two_fullM6E1 (q i : ℕ) :
 let P := fib6 (q+2)^2+V*fib6 (q+1)^2
 coeff P i (q+1)*coeff P (i+2) (q+1) ≤ coeff P (i+1) (q+1)^2

theorem central_positiveM6E1 (q k : ℕ) :

def InteriorCore63M6E1 : Prop := ∀ path : List Bool,
 let m := (frame path).mid
 2 ≤ m.a →
 (∀ i j, InPolygon m.a m.b i j → InPolygon m.a m.b (i+1) j →
   InPolygon m.a m.b (i+2) j → i+j+4 ≤ m.a+m.b-1 → 5 ≤ j →
   ¬HorizontalMiddleMF1E m.a m.b i j →
   ¬(HorizontalRegionMAC3 m.a m.b i j ∨ HorizontalVarianceMAC3 m.a m.b i j) →
   ¬HorizontalSharpM37B m.a m.b i j →
   ¬(m.a=2 ∧ m.b=2*j+1) →
   coeff m.p i j*coeff m.p (i+2) j ≤ coeff m.p (i+1) j^2) ∧
 (∀ i j, InPolygon m.a m.b i j → InPolygon m.a m.b i (j+1) →
   InPolygon m.a m.b i (j+2) → i+j+4 ≤ m.a+m.b-1 → 4 ≤ i → 3 ≤ j →
   ¬VerticalMiddleMF1E m.a m.b i j →
   ¬(VerticalRegionMAC3 m.a m.b i j ∨ VerticalVarianceMAC3 m.a m.b i j) →
   ¬VerticalSharpM37B m.a m.b i j →
   coeff m.p i j*coeff m.p i (j+2) ≤ coeff m.p i (j+1)^2) ∧
 (∀ i j, InPolygon m.a m.b i (j+2) → InPolygon m.a m.b (i+1) (j+1) →
   InPolygon m.a m.b (i+2) j → i+j+8 ≤ m.a+m.b-1 → m.a+5 ≤ i+j+2 →
   m.a+2 ≤ m.b → ¬DiagonalMiddleMF1E m.a m.b i j →
   ¬(DiagonalRegionMAC3 m.a m.b i j ∨ DiagonalVarianceMAC3 m.a m.b i j) →
   ¬DiagonalSharpM37B m.a m.b i j →
   coeff m.p i (j+2)*coeff m.p (i+2) j ≤ coeff m.p (i+1) (j+1)^2)
